engine-api.title: Engine API — node :3100 (internal only)
engine-api.cond: Auth: HS256 JWT {id, isAdmin} minted per request by cab. Guards: admin · org = owner/organiser · chair = room judge (falls through to org). Never public.

phoenix-api.title: Phoenix API — /api/v1 (cab)
phoenix-api.cond: Session cookie today; keyed public API = pillar 3. Green = the engine call behind the write.

admin.title: Admin
admin.cond: is_admin only (404 otherwise). Club creation is admin-only.

owner.title: Owner (club head)
owner.cond: The owner never plays. Lifecycle: sign-ups → Close sign-ups → compose rooms → MONITOR only while running → Finish session · Cancel session. Set/release motion, ballots and finish room belong to each room's judge.

member.title: Member
member.cond: Member of several clubs — fine. Becomes Participant/Judge by registering.

participant.title: Participant (registered speaker)
participant.cond: Member or guest. The guest's /l/:code shows ONLY their session/room view — no club-local pages. History lives on the club page table, nowhere else.

judge.title: Judge (chairs a room)
judge.cond: Member-judge or guest-judge (link) — the judge PLAYS the room: edit draw, set + release motion, ballot, finish room. Judge before rooms exist = spectator. Guest judges see only their session via /l/:code.
